descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
CLAY 2 is a relaxing VR pottery studio for Meta Quest, built for kids and families. Pastel walls, a rubber play-tile floor in every colour, a cloud ceiling, smiling stars and rainbows on the walls and balloons at the ceiling - and outside the glass door, rolling green hills, hot-air balloons, kites and a castle under a rainbow.

SHAPE IT WITH YOUR HANDS
Hand tracking puts your real fingertip on the clay. Squeeze it tall, open a pot, pull the walls up, push out a belly or pinch in a neck - the clay keeps its volume, like the real thing. Controllers work too, with a little stylus finger.

FIVE POTTER'S WHEELS
Two wheels by the big windows, two in the kiln room with the glaze buckets and drying racks, and one out on the balcony facing the cartoon world. Each wheel is its own colour and remembers the pot you left on it.

SEVEN DRIPPING GLAZES
Four clay bodies and seven glazes - celadon, cobalt, tenmoku, honey, speckled white, turquoise and sunset - shown on your pot straight away.

KEEP YOUR FAVOURITES
Press KEEP and your finished pot flies onto the My Pots shelf, fired and glazed, with a sparkle and a chime. Everything you make is saved on your headset.

NO WRONG ANSWERS
No score, no timer, no losing. Walk up to a wheel and it starts spinning; walk away and it stops. Gentle sounds, relaxed music from the studio radio, and nothing that can go wrong.

Developed and published by Citiview Group.
